_comment: Hand-written example of the SignalReport that feed.py expects from Claude. Used by offline mode so the pipeline runs without an API key. Run `python run.py --live` to replace it with a real extraction.

signals.rationale: Packaging lines in Taiwan shut by typhoon; operators cite 2-3 weeks to requalify.
Export licence review directly delays optical modules from Chinese makers.
A Korean HBM maker has a yield excursion with one quarter of allocation cuts; which of the two Korean makers is ambiguous.
Transformer lead times in ERCOT now exceed 18 months, so replacing a failed unit takes far longer.
Retail news with no bearing on the network.
A second liquid-cooled line at the Mexican integrator adds redundancy.
